title: Rulet
description: This resource pack replaces the standard bread item with the legendary Russian poppy seed roll (Rulet s makom) with high-quality 128x textures.
body:
# 🥮 Russian Snacks: Poppy Seed Roll

Add a touch of Russian culture to your Minecraft experience! This high-quality resource pack replaces the standard vanilla Bread with a legendary poppy seed roll. This specific version features the most iconic and "fancy" flavor: Poppy Seed.

### 🌍 Cultural Context
In Eastern Europe, this sweet pastry is a cult-classic comfort food. The Poppy Seed flavor is a fan-favorite, combining the simple tradition of sweet bread with the taste of a world-famous delicacy. It's a perfect piece of authentic "Slavic core" for your game!

---

### ✨ Key Features
* **Authentic Look:** Highly detailed 128x texture inspired by the classic fresh baking.
* **Poppy Seed Edition:** Replaces the generic bread item with a high-status cultural snack.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Fits perfectly into custom survival servers and themed modpacks.

---

### ⚙️ Technical Notes & Compatibility
Due to the custom models and texture resolution, some users may experience stability issues or rare glitches on specific Minecraft versions or when using heavy optimization mods.

* If you encounter any visual bugs, try reloading your textures in-game by pressing **F3 + T**.
* If you face **any problems, questions, or game crashes**, please report them on my **GitHub Issues** page, and I will help you fix them.
